comment:exclude: playwright.config.ts + vrt/** are Playwright-owned: contracts.spec.ts (the CI behaviour gate) and components.spec.ts (the local before/after capture driven by tooling/vrt-review.mjs). They are typechecked by Playwright's own tsconfig at run time, not by the Next build, so excluding them keeps `next build` and the local typecheck free of @playwright/test types.
